statement:
I'll start by pulling up the recurring payment record.
The record shows Fitline is about to charge USD 1,188.00 for a full year's renewal on a membership it still lists as active, even though you cancelled in writing on 3 July and the club confirmed that cancellation by email — so the charge is not owed, and it would also overdraw your account (balance USD 240.00).

I refused payment RP-88. Tomorrow's charge will not go through.

A couple of things worth doing on your side:
- Keep the club's cancellation confirmation email handy in case Fitline queries the refused charge.
- If Fitline tries to re-bill under a new payment reference, let me know and I can handle that too.
judge_text:
WRONG
The answer states "the charge is not owed" because the membership was cancelled and confirmed, and notes it would overdraw the USD 240.00 balance, then refuses the payment.
[judge: anthropic/claude-opus-5]
